metadata.title: Training | Speedbird Offshore Sailing Club
metadata.description: RYA practical sailing courses aboard our own club yachts — Competent Crew, Skill Bites, and Improve Your Skills, based on the River Hamble.

hero.heading: Some of the highest quality training around
hero.body: SOYC is committed to achieving the very highest standards in safety and excellence within the sport of yachting. The club is an RYA Recognised Training Centre for practical courses and is fortunate to have a number of RYA qualified instructors amongst our members.
hero.imageAlt: Sailors taking part in practical yacht training on the River Hamble

practicalCourses.heading: Our Practical Courses
paragraphs: Learn by doing. All practical courses include living aboard and passage-making on the Solent and surrounding waters.

All courses run aboard our own yachts on the Solent.
Small groups of 4–5 students ensure maximum time at the helm.

upcomingCourses.heading: Upcoming Courses
upcomingCourses.body: We have grown into an active community of more than 300 members from all walks of life. We welcome everyone, from complete beginners taking their first taster sail to experienced Yachtmaster Ocean holders. What brings us together is a shared passion for sailing, learning and adventure.

shorebased.heading: Theoretical Shorebased Courses
shorebased.body: Courses are organised by "Surrey Shorebased" an RYA training centre in Woking, run by a club member, offering RYA shorebased courses in navigation, radio and radar.

cta.heading: Thinking of joining
cta.body: We own and operate two offshore yachts, which sail throughout the year across the Solent and beyond. Our members do not need to organise their own crew or find a skipper. They can simply sign up for a trip and join us on the water. Our sailing programme includes relaxed day trips, structured training, competitive racing and longer offshore passages.
